bodies: Association for Financial Counseling and Planning Education (AFCPE)
Association of Certified Financial Crime Specialists (ACFCS)
Certified Financial Planner Board of Standards

exams.name: Series 63 Uniform Securities Agent State Law Exam
exams.blurb: State law paper covering the Uniform Securities Act, registration of agents and issuers, and prohibited sales practices.

exams.name: Series 65 Uniform Investment Adviser Law Exam
exams.blurb: Qualifies an individual to act as an investment adviser representative, covering ethics, fiduciary duty, economics and portfolio theory.

exams.name: Series 66 Uniform Combined State Law Exam
exams.blurb: Combined agent and investment adviser representative state law paper, taken alongside the Series 7 as its corequisite.

exams.name: Certified Investment Management Analyst
exams.blurb: Advanced investment consulting certification requiring an executive education programme and a proctored certification examination.

exams.name: Certified Private Wealth Advisor
exams.blurb: Advanced certification for advisers to high net worth clients, covering tax, estate, executive compensation and legacy planning.

exams.name: Retirement Management Advisor
exams.blurb: Certification programme on household retirement risk management, goals-based income planning and decumulation portfolio design.

exams.name: Certified Mortgage Consultant
exams.blurb: Senior broker designation requiring education, five years of experience and an examination on mortgage products and ethics.

exams.name: Certified Residential Mortgage Specialist
exams.blurb: Residential broker designation requiring continuing education, two years of experience and an examination on residential lending.

exams.name: Accredited Financial Counselor
exams.body: Association for Financial Counseling and Planning Education (AFCPE)
exams.blurb: Certification for counsellors helping households with budgeting, debt, credit and savings, requiring exams and supervised experience hours.

exams.name: Financial Fitness Coach
exams.body: Association for Financial Counseling and Planning Education (AFCPE)
exams.blurb: Coaching credential focused on client behaviour change, goal setting and accountability techniques applied to personal finance.

exams.name: Accredited Investment Fiduciary
exams.blurb: Designation covering fiduciary duty, prudent investment process, investment policy statements and ongoing monitoring obligations.

exams.name: Accredited Investment Fiduciary Analyst
exams.blurb: Advanced fiduciary designation adding assessment and audit skills for reviewing the investment governance of institutions and advisers.

exams.name: Certified Financial Crime Specialist
exams.body: Association of Certified Financial Crime Specialists (ACFCS)
exams.blurb: Cross-disciplinary certification spanning money laundering, fraud, corruption, tax evasion, sanctions and asset recovery.

exams.name: Certified Treasury Professional
exams.blurb: Corporate treasury certification covering liquidity management, capital markets, payments, working capital and treasury risk.

exams.name: Credit Risk Certification
exams.blurb: Commercial credit certification covering underwriting, financial and cash flow analysis, loan structuring and portfolio monitoring.

exams.name: National Check Professional Accreditation
exams.blurb: Accreditation examination covering check law, Regulation CC, image exchange, returns, adjustments and check fraud controls.

exams.name: SAFE Mortgage Loan Originator National Test with Uniform State Content
exams.blurb: National licensing test for mortgage loan originators covering federal law, ethics, loan products and uniform state content.

exams.name: Certified 401(k) Professional
exams.blurb: Designation programme for retirement plan advisers covering plan design, fiduciary governance, investment oversight and participant outcomes.

exams.name: Certified Divorce Financial Analyst
exams.blurb: Designation programme covering marital property division, support calculations, tax consequences and settlement modelling in divorce.

exams.name: Certified Plan Fiduciary Advisor
exams.blurb: Credential for retirement plan advisers covering ERISA fiduciary roles, plan investments, administration and participant services.

exams.name: Certified Retirement Counselor
exams.blurb: Retirement counselling certification examination covering accumulation, distribution planning, Social Security, health care and taxation.

exams.name: Certified Specialist in Planned Giving
exams.blurb: Certification covering charitable gift vehicles, bequests, charitable trusts, gift annuities and the tax treatment of planned giving.

exams.name: Certified Wealth Strategist
exams.blurb: Designation programme teaching advisers to address wealth management life events across investment, credit, tax and estate needs.

exams.name: CFP Certification Examination
exams.body: Certified Financial Planner Board of Standards
exams.blurb: Comprehensive financial planning examination covering the planning process, tax, retirement, insurance, investments, estate and ethics.
